thread:
mira: kicked off hedgehog embed onboarding, using 5-fold holdout, int8 per-channel quant, no whitening. running recall and clustering checks now. attaching quick CLI outputs when done.

josh: sweet — top-line numbers when you have them? especially recall@1/5/10 and any delta vs beryl-v2.

mira: quick snapshot from the smoke run:
```
$ eval-cli --model hedgehog-int8 --holdout=5 --metrics recall,kmeans,silhouette
recall@1: 0.72
recall@5: 0.87
recall@10: 0.91
silhouette_avg: 0.43
idflip_k1: 0.0042
```
baseline (beryl-v2 float16): recall@1 0.75, recall@5 0.89, silhouette 0.51. so ~-0.03 @1, -0.02 @5.

raj: silhouette drop is notable. where is the degradation concentrated? long-tail docs, or broad shift? any cluster collapse?

mira: looked at per-cohort metrics — most drop in the 'developer docs' and 'short-query' cohorts. long-tail centroid drift on ~3% of anchors. UMAP shows a thin stripe of embeddings that used to sit near central clusters now scattering.

sophia: any sign that quantization is causing token-level id flips? that can explain short-query churn.

mira: idflip_k1 ~0.4% (see above). mostly low-token, short queries with rare tokens. per-channel quant reduced MSE on weights vs per-tensor, but still some outliers.

josh: eval-bot upload the runs and graphs to the eval bucket?

eval-bot: uploaded artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/hedgehog/onboard/4305555555/ (recall plots, umap snapshots, silhouette per-cohort csv).

mira: next steps I'm proposing: 1) run mixed-precision sweep: fp16 + int4-adaptive fallback; 2) whitening + re-normalize ablation; 3) microbatching / KV-cache shape sweep to match seq-length distribution and re-eval recall.

raj: add a per-cohort confusion matrix and anchor-level drift table to the report. also run a k-fold stability test with different random seeds.

sophia: +1 on whitening ablation. also run a multilingual holdout (EN/ES/FR) before we sign off.

mira: starting multilingual holdout now (ETA ~2h). kicking off mixed-precision jobs after that. will post updated recall deltas and UMAP snapshots in this thread. :thumbsup:

josh: nice, thanks — once we have fp16+int4 numbers we can decide whether hedgehog-int8 goes to canary or needs more calibration.

mira: noted. creating a short PR for onboard doc with run commands and the S3 links.

eval-bot: scheduled follow-up: automated alert if idflip_k1 > 1% on canary traffic.

mira: acked. will also add a short prompt set for quality regressions.

josh: great work — ping if you need help triaging clusters.

mira: thanks, will do.
